Container.Name: PriceBuddies
Container.Overview: Self-hosted price tracker (fork of jez500/pricebuddy). Single container with SQLite: no database container needed. Data, settings and the app key are stored in the Data path. For JavaScript-heavy shops, also install the PriceBuddies-Scraper template and set the Scraper URL.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (database.sqlite), .env with app key, logs and uploads

Config.Name: Admin e-mail
Config.Description: First admin account (only used on first start)

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: First admin password (only used on first start; change it later in Account settings)

Config.Name: Scraper URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL of the PriceBuddies-Scraper container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3030

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL you open PriceBuddies on, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 (used in e-mails/links)

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: sqlite (default). Use mysql only with your own MySQL server and DB_HOST/DB_USERNAME/DB_PASSWORD/DB_DATABASE.

Config.Name: Default stores
Config.Description: Store presets created on first start
